candidate_relations.reason: Autoimmune encephalitis does not preserve the required bismuth-toxic etiology and was only an empiric presumptive diagnosis despite clinical worsening on immunotherapy.
The candidate explicitly identifies bismuth encephalopathy, matching the full reference diagnosis; the parenthetical toxic/metabolic category is compatible.
Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease is a prion disease rather than bismuth encephalopathy; the normal MRI and absence of periodic EEG features also do not support it here.
